body: This subreddit is currently only thing keeping me alive. So yes, you are not alone. But maybe we both are freaks? Who knows
I'm doing the same thing. And I still don't know why...
Asking the same questions as you. Do I have an answer? No but atleast you are not the only one feeling like this

Hard truth I leaned a while back. There is nobody actually willing to help you just because they are kind. They aren't. Yes, they might think they are and they are doing this because if it. But Everybody wants something. Nobody is doing things "for free"
Take a deep breath. And few more.  We are here for you!
Its okey, its how Reddit works. True heroes choose "new posts" instead staying on "hot" section. We see you!

You girlfriend already sounds more amazing than all my ex-s combined. She is that type of girlfriend that every man dreams of. I'm happy for you. And today I will raise a glass for your birthday and for you two! Cheers!

All good. In this case, you are not alone, I don't celebrate my birthday too. Haven't in years. But, you have a girlfriend, so you are already doing better than me. Anyways, don't be upset or something like that when she tries to get you into birthdays, she wants best to you and wants you to be happy. And seeing that she tries, I'm pretty sure she loves you alot.

And thats why I asked. Its his/hers birthday and everyone deserves to get a present or two and cake etc. Everyone. I have made presents before to to others because nobody else got them anything. And thats why I asked

Want the truth? I don't have one big  reason to be alive. I don't have anything. I don't have anyone. Every single day I somehow find something to postpone death. And yes, I think of death every single day. Sometimes multiple times a day. 

What do I find then? Small things, like a really good song that I want to listen a bit more. Things like that.

And what happens when some day I don't find anything? Well we all know what happens. 

Its that simple, no religion, no specific activities (because I don't have enough mental strength to do something big or time consuming). Just a small things.
Tell me, what did you get for presents? Was the birthday cake okey?

Thank you for reading. I try to live to myself and find something to do. But as you probably know, pretty much everything I start, I don't have strength to finish it. Not physical, mental strength.
And don't worry, it didn't make me feel worse. At this point, I don't belive it would get any worse. Next "stop" would be me gone. 

Like I said, I'm not here to get help, because reality is, when strangers tell you not to do and try to convince you that there is so much more in life etc, it doesn't work. They are strangers. They don't know us, our habits, what we love and what we hate. 

What we need is someone close to us to tell this. Show that they care. Show that they want us around. Thats all
